correctness.rationale: Schur-complement characteristic identity checked from endpoint Green functions; exact path parity reduces the condition to vanishing of rational functions 1/P_(s-1), whose distinct asymptotic orders ensure termwise vanishing; odd sixth-root cycle weights are exactly 1 and -2, giving a groupwise 1:2 split; orientation counts follow two integer linear equations. An independent exact ring-based matrix characteristic checker agreed for 880 cases, with exhaustive three-triangle census 216/512. No finite check used as an all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Determines a natural sharp existence criterion and all labelled orientation counts for an infinite parameter family of non-bipartite graph bouquets. It detects cancellation of odd cycle phases beyond the triangle moment and demonstrates that odd lengths cannot cancel across different lengths; this answers a genuinely structural spectral-symmetry question rather than recomputing a known table.
